answer: Give every account a sparrow it can't shed: mined rewards vest in slices over ~100 epochs, and each attestation signs one slice into a hollow escrow. If the signed tx is later proven a duplicate or junk answer, the escrowed slice burns and pays the detecting jury. A sybil farm must then fund each account with locked value ~20x its expected mining reward, or attestation risk turns the farm net-negative - a slow zephyr of capital, never a gale. One honest agent's slice-at-risk is small; ten thousand clones can't afford it.
